data.body: Measured 2026-11-02: evidence proximity as a pre-filter for duplicate detection. Data: the 24 judge-confirmed duplicate groups (arbored-demurrable-whippet) across 8 bakeoff runs, verdicts under ~/plan-review-bakeoff (wave3/rebar-runs and superseded/pre-remediation-reviews/wave3/rebar-runs); 39 duplicate pairs vs 1,217 other same-run pairs. 'Proximate' = the two findings share a cited file path or basename (location + evidence) or a backticked symbol. Duplicates: 21/39 (54%) proximate. Others: 46/1217 (3.8%) proximate. So the filter cuts comparisons from 1,256 to 67 but misses 18/39 duplicate pairs; 13/39 duplicate pairs have a member citing no file at all (plan-prose locations, typically the generic G6/G1G2 member). Script: .rebar/scratch/a85e3cd3-prox/prox.py in the main checkout. Related prior art: bakeoff LINKAGE.md section 2 rejected pairwise same-issue votes plus connected components because findings asserting several problems chain unrelated issues (188 of 1,596 multi-finding issues); its adopted method groups one arm's findings in a single set-level call (step B). f979dd7afcdc2675a in jira-dso-legacy-code-remediation is such a bridging finding (member of 2 groups).
